//: TRACKED BASE CONFIGURATION. It must stay free of credentials: this file is in git, and every clone, every CI checkout and every published image inherits it. The PostgreSQL connection string therefore lives in appsettings.Development.json (git-ignored, copy appsettings.Development.template.json) or in the ConnectionStrings__CatalogDbConnectionString environment variable. A guard test, Test/UnitTest/Infrastructure/Configuration/TrackedConfigurationTests.cs, fails the build if a ConnectionStrings section or any password assignment ever reappears here.
//Migrations: Schema. ApplyOnStartup is false because DDL belongs in an explicit step: 'dotnet Catalog.WebApi.dll --migrate'. Leave it true only for a local 'dotnet run'. TimeoutSeconds bounds the whole run (both contexts) so a migration job against an unreachable database fails instead of hanging.
//Seed: Sample catalogue data (30 foods / 25 recipes / 2 plans). False everywhere by default, including production. Seeding is idempotent by data check, but running it on every boot is still the wrong default; enable it per environment when you want an empty database populated.
//Swagger: OpenAPI document and UI. False by default: it is a full description of the internal API surface. Turn it on where you want it served (compose sets Swagger__Enabled=true).
//HttpsRedirection: False by default because TLS terminates upstream (ingress, gateway or mesh sidecar) and plain HTTP is what reaches this process. Turn it on only where this process really is the TLS edge, i.e. Kestrel published with a certificate.
